task: Pick up the CUP and place it on the TABLE.
plan_summary: Navigate robot CAR to the CUP, pick it up, navigate to the TABLE, and place the CUP on the TABLE.
assumptions: Robot CAR can navigate freely to the target coordinates.
The interaction distance of 2.0 allows successful pick and place operations when the robot is within the specified tolerance of the target coordinates.
The CUP and TABLE are unobstructed and accessible.
